list_spaces: list spaces on the Hub with optional search, filter, sort, and limit parameters
search_spaces: search spaces on the Hub using semantic search with optional SDK filter and description display
get_space_info: get detailed info about a specific space on the Hub including expandable properties
enable_dev_mode: enable dev mode on a Space for faster debugging and iterative development
hot_reload_file: hot-reload a Python file in a Gradio Space without a full rebuild and restart
